# FQHESphereWithSpinSingleModeApproximation

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereWithSpinSingleModeApproximation`

```text
FQHESphereSingleModeApproximation, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereSingleModeApproximation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --ground-state : name of the file containing the ground state vector upon which rho_k acts
    --fermion : use fermionic statistics (default value))
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (override autodetection from input file name if non zero) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -z, --total-lz : twice the total lz value of the system (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -s, --total-sz : twice the total sz value of the system (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -A, --all-sz : assume a hilbert space including all sz values
    --lz-boost : Lz momentum that has to be transfer via the SMA (default value = 0)
    --spin-indices : 0 for c_{up,M}^+ c_{up,M+boost}, 1 for c_{up,M}^+ c_{down,M+boost}, 2 for c_{down,M}^+ c_{up,M+boost}, 3 for c_{down,M}^+ c_{down,M+boost} (default value = 0)
    --compute-bilinears : compute the action of all the bilinear operators on the ground state
    --compute-spinwave : compute the spin-wave excitation (one spin flip relative to ground state) with the given momentum L=lz-boost
    --compute-sma : compute the SMA excitation by acting with rho (up or down) with the given momentum L=lz-boost. Specify whether spin-up or spin-down using the spin-indices option!
    --interaction-name : interaction name (as it should appear in output files)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

Lanczos options:

precalculation options:
    -m, --memory : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast multiplication (in Mbytes) (default value = 500)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

tools options:

global options:
```
